description: Retrieves all comments from an existing Figma file, identified by a valid `file_key`, returning details like content, author, position, and reactions, with an option for Markdown formatted content.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for `GetCommentsInAFile` action. Specifies the file and formatting options for retrieving comments.

as_md.description: If true, comment content will be returned in Markdown format where applicable (e.g., for links, bold text). Defaults to false, returning rich text structure.
as_md.title: As Md

file_key.description: Identifier for the Figma file from which to retrieve comments. This can be a file key (a unique string identifying a file) or a branch key. To obtain a branch key, use the `GET /v1/files/:key` endpoint with the `branch_data` query parameter.
file_key.title: File Key

inputSchema.title: GetCommentsInAFileRequest

name: get_comments_in_a_file

x.description: The X coordinate of a vector, typically representing an absolute position on the Figma canvas.
x.title: X

y.description: The Y coordinate of a vector, typically representing an absolute position on the Figma canvas.
y.title: Y

node_id.description: Unique identifier of the Figma node (e.g., frame, component) to which the comment is anchored.
node_id.title: Node Id

node_offset.description: A 2D vector representing the offset of the comment pin from the top-left corner of the anchored `node_id`.
node_offset.title: Node Offset

stable_path.description: Array of node IDs representing the path from the root to the comment's node. Used for stable comment positioning.
stable_path.title: Stable Path

comment_pin_corner.description: Defines which corner of the rectangular comment region is located at the absolute canvas coordinates (`x`, `y`). For example, if 'top-left', then (`x`,`y`) are the top-left coordinates of the region.
comment_pin_corner.title: Comment Pin Corner

region_height.description: Height of the comment's rectangular region on the canvas. Must be a positive value.
region_height.title: Region Height

region_width.description: Width of the comment's rectangular region on the canvas. Must be a positive value.
region_width.title: Region Width

x.description: Absolute X coordinate of the comment region's anchor corner on the Figma canvas.
x.title: X

y.description: Absolute Y coordinate of the comment region's anchor corner on the Figma canvas.
y.title: Y

comment_pin_corner.description: Defines which corner of the comment region is pinned at the `node_offset` position relative to the `node_id`.
comment_pin_corner.title: Comment Pin Corner

node_id.description: Unique identifier of the Figma node to which the comment region is anchored.
node_id.title: Node Id

node_offset.description: A 2D vector representing the offset of the comment region's anchor corner from the top-left of the `node_id`.
node_offset.title: Node Offset

region_height.description: Height of the comment's rectangular region, anchored to a node. Must be a positive value.
region_height.title: Region Height

region_width.description: Width of the comment's rectangular region, anchored to a node. Must be a positive value.
region_width.title: Region Width

stable_path.description: Array of node IDs representing the path from the root to the comment's node. Used for stable comment positioning.
stable_path.title: Stable Path

client_meta.description:
Positioning data for the comment, detailing its location and type (point or region) on the canvas. The structure of this field varies based on how the comment is placed:
- `ClientMeta`: Absolute canvas coordinates (x, y) for a point comment.
- `ClientMeta1`: Node-relative offset (`node_id`, `node_offset`) for a point comment.
- `ClientMeta2`: Absolute canvas coordinates (`x`, `y` for an anchor corner), region dimensions (`region_width`, `region_height`), and `comment_pin_corner` for a region comment.
- `ClientMeta3`: Node-relative offset (`node_id`, `node_offset` for an anchor corner), region dimensions, and `comment_pin_corner` for a region comment.
Can be null for comments without specific positioning metadata.
client_meta.title: Client Meta

created_at.description: Timestamp in UTC ISO 8601 format indicating when the comment was created.
created_at.title: Created At

file_key.description: Identifier of the Figma file containing this comment.
file_key.title: File Key

message.description: The text content of the comment. May include mentions or rich text elements if `as_md` is false, or Markdown content if `as_md` is true.
message.title: Message

order_id.description: A string representing the numerical identifier (e.g., '1', '2') displayed with the comment in the Figma UI. This is typically present only for top-level comments and reflects their visible ordering.
order_id.title: Order Id

parent_id.description: Identifier of the parent comment if this comment is a reply. Null or absent for top-level comments.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

reactions.description: A list of all reactions made to this comment.
reactions.title: Reactions

resolved_at.description: Timestamp in UTC ISO 8601 format indicating when the comment was resolved. Null or absent if the comment is not resolved.
resolved_at.title: Resolved At

user.description: Details of the user who created the comment.
user.title: User

uuid.description: A UUID that uniquely identifies the comment. This can be used for stable referencing of comments.
uuid.title: Uuid

GetCommentsInAFileResponse.description: Response schema for `GetCommentsInAFile` action. Contains the retrieved comments.

comments.description: A list of comment objects retrieved from the Figma file.
comments.title: Comments

GetCommentsInAFileResponse.title: GetCommentsInAFileResponse

emoji.title: Emoji

user.title: User

handle.description: Display name or handle of the Figma user.
handle.title: Handle

id.title: Id
